rows.title: feat(evm): add XDC Network (50) and XDC Apothem testnet (51) default assets
rows.author: AnilChinchawale
rows.summary: Adds **XDC Network** mainnet (`eip155:50`) and **XDC Apothem** testnet (`eip155:51`) to the EVM default-asset registries, following [`DEFAULT_ASSETS.md`](https://github.com/coinbase/x402/blob/main/DEFAULT_ASSETS.md). This lets USD-string pricing (`price: "$0.10"`) resolve to native USDC on XDC out of the box, across all three SDKs.

rows.title: test(python/evm): add unit tests for FacilitatorWeb3Signer methods

rows.title: fix(examples/ts): align custom client env vars with .env-local
rows.author: feldmannn
rows.summary: The TypeScript custom client example at `examples/typescript/clients/custom/index.ts` reads `process.env.SERVER_URL` (which is not declared in this example's `.env-local`) and hardcodes the path `/weather`. As a result, developers following the `.env-local` template see no effect from their edits: the env-var fallback `http://localhost:4021` always wins, and the path is unconfigurable despite `.env-local` providing `ENDPOINT_PATH`.
